project.title: XARP (ACM SIGCHI EICS 2026)
project.caption: Declarative Python agent toolkit for building extended reality applications
project.description: A collaboration with Ph.D. candidate Arthur Caetano and the UCSB Human-AI Integration Lab, XARP is a declarative Python agent toolkit for building extended reality applications. It allows developers to create intelligent agents that can perceive, reason, and act in virtual environments, enabling the creation of immersive and interactive experiences.
